note: Each edit replaces text in one line of the recovered listing, or inserts a line; the build re-tokenizes only those lines and keeps every other byte.

edits.reason: PM sizes the move lists in line 15. Rooks, bishops and queens list some squares two or three times, so busy positions passed 120 entries and stopped with ?BS Error in 3015 or 3500. 300 entries cost about 4 KB.
Their pawn on row 8 was never promoted: RN was set to 0 before the test. The test now comes first; line 111 clears the move afterwards, as before.
The statements moved from line 110, so a second ADD still does not repeat the move.
Line 2000's routine always leaves by GOTO, so this GOSUB never returned and every searched move left a frame on BASIC's stack. GOTO does the same without the leak.
Our pawns could step two squares from any row, even off the board to row 0; now only from row 7, where they start.
Our pawn on row 1 was never promoted: the test looked at the square it moves to, which never holds our pawn. It now looks at the pawn's square, so line 1320 moves a queen.
The opening moved whatever stood on its square, wherever it was going. Each move now needs its own piece at home and a clear path, and must not land on one of its own pieces.
